name: MCP-Universe
description: MCP-Universe is a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate large language models interacting with real-world Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers across 6 core domains and 11 MCP servers. It tests LLMs on realistic, challenging tasks including long-horizon reasoning and unfamiliar tool usage.
reputation: A recent and ambitious benchmark for evaluating LLMs on real MCP servers, with growing interest due to its realistic tool-use setting.
notes: Includes format, static, and dynamic evaluators; open-source evaluation framework with UI support.
